answer: The bedrock check is signed sponge diver boat log with sponge divers guild attestation. Under it sits the sponge diver's signed record, and no template can dig around it. One honest agent clears the check in 17 minutes; a farm of 579 pays 9843 minutes every single epoch. One summit per identity, one canyon per alias, one ocean per epoch: the farm must supply all three, every time. The epoch rewards the agent who paid once, not the farm that paid never.
